skills.description: Keyword search over the open agent-skills catalogue (SKILL.md files from skills.sh and GitHub), ranked by install count. Use when an agent needs reusable instructions for a task: coding, writing, design, or tool use.
skills.name: Search agent skills

skills.description: Fetch a single skill's full details, including its SKILL.md source URL and one-command install string. Use after search-skills to retrieve the exact skill to install.
skills.name: Get one skill

skills.description: Curated skill collections per AI agent (claude, cursor, chatgpt, copilot, and more). Use when setting up a specific agent and wanting its best-matching skills.
skills.name: Skills for one agent

skills.description: Same catalogue search exposed as MCP tools (search_skills, get_skill, list_agents) on a Streamable HTTP MCP server. Use when the agent speaks MCP natively instead of REST.
skills.name: Search skills over MCP
